key_insight: Frozen medical LLMs/VLMs can keep improving after deployment by learning from past cases through external skill, knowledge, and multimodal memory rather than weight updates.
clinical_relevance: This could help clinical AI stay aligned with new evidence and workflows while preserving earlier performance, which is important in fast-changing medical settings.
method: Adds a Skill module for reasoning and tool use.
Stores trusted facts in a Knowledge Memory and visual examples in a Multimodal Knowledge Base.
Uses an online validation rule that accepts updates only if they help new cases without hurting prior ones.
evidence_signal: Evaluated across six benchmarks with four open-weight and closed-source models, showing up to a 34.2% improvement over the base model on medical tasks and transfer to unseen cases.
watch_item: Because the approach depends on retrieved external memory and online update rules, real-world performance may vary with case quality, retrieval reliability, and deployment context.
paper_title: Frozen Models, Evolving Expertise: Model-Agnostic Learning from Deployment Experience for Multimodal Medical AI
